title: Brawl erupts in Brazil’s Women’s League final
html:
Brawl erupts in Brazil’s Women’s League final

A fist fight erupted between opposing players during the final of Brazil’s under-20 Women’s League between Corinthians and Ferroviaria. The fight stopped the match for 6 minutes during the second-half and 3 people were ejected. The game ended with a 2-0 win in favour of Ferroviaria.
summary: A fist fight erupted between opposing players during the final of Brazil's under-20 Women’s League.
